diagnostics.interpretation: Geometric fidelity of the picture only. Not a match score and not a hiring probability.

information_loss.statement: This 2-D map keeps 24.9% of the total variance across 52 features; 75.1% is not visible. On average 11% of a point's 10 nearest map neighbours are true nearest neighbours in the full feature space. Rank agreement between map distances and full-space distances is 0.70 (1.00 would be perfect). For the median posting, 76% of its squared distance from the average posting lies outside the map. Read the map as a sketch. Use full-space distances and the gap analysis for decisions.
